findings.title: Malformed or incomplete stats response crashes the page and leaves the previous range's table on screen under 'Loading stats…'
findings.expected: A visible error and no uncaught exception; data for the old range is not shown as the result for the new range
findings.actual: Uncaught 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'length')'; the page stays on 'Loading stats…' and still shows the 1 Jan to 31 Dec 2026 table and Best plants while From reads 2026-06-02

findings.title: Clearing the From date gives a contradictory 'From must be on or before To' error instead of an open start
findings.expected: With From blank and To = 2025-12-31, stats from the beginning up to To, or a clear prompt to enter a From date
findings.actual: The page sends only to=2025-12-31; the server fills From with 1 Jan of this year (2026) and answers 422; the page shows 'The From date must be on or before the To date.' even though From is empty
findings.evidence: {"alerts":["The From date must be on or before the To date."],"fields":[{"label":"From","value":""},{"label":"To","value":"2025-12-31"}]} | {"alerts":["The From date must be on or before the To date."],"fields":[{"label":"From","value":""},{"label":"To","value":"2025-12-31"}]}

findings.title: Clearing the To date quietly falls back to 31 Dec of this year
findings.expected: A blank To is refused or shown clearly; the range shown matches the inputs
findings.actual: To field blank, URL ?from=2025-03-01, results say '6 harvests from 1 Mar 2025 to 31 Dec 2026'

findings.title: A stats request that hangs leaves 'Loading stats…' forever, with old data still showing
findings.expected: A timeout with an error and a way to retry
findings.actual: 13 s after changing From, the page still shows 'Loading stats…' above the previous range's Best plants and table
